codeReview.summary: The worker successfully fixed the targeted critical TypeScript errors across two worker sessions (301ba49e-43ca-4247-b1ba-51f035f65476 and 76415ec7-0dda-4041-9399-2b832ac8f45d). The changes focused on SaleItem businessId addition, distribucion types, SyncStatusValue mismatches, and API route issues. The targeted files now have zero type errors.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The worker used `as any` type assertions as a workaround for complex type conflicts between Sale/SaleWithItems and Product type mismatches. While effective for immediate fixes, this pattern may mask underlying schema inconsistencies that should be addressed in future refactoring.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: new-sale.tsx and purchase-calculator-content.tsx use `as any` casts for SaleWithItems vs Sale compatibility and Product type syncAttempts conflicts

sharedStateObservations.observation: Generated files in lib/sync/generated/ contain 100+ pre-existing type errors that are out of scope for manual fixes. These require generator updates (separate milestone m2-regenerate-and-verify).
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Generated hooks.ts and services.ts have type mismatches with actual API endpoints (customerGroups, distribucionItems, productVariants, etc. don't exist on API type)

sharedStateObservations.observation: The Date vs string type inconsistency between drizzle (Date) and service interfaces (string) is a systemic issue affecting multiple files. The worker applied targeted fixes but noted this requires broader refactoring.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: product-service.ts has multiple Date→string conversion casts (lines 170-190); similar issues exist in cart-utils.ts and other files

sharedStateObservations.observation: SyncStatusValue type alias doesn't match string literal unions used in some consumers, causing TS2820 errors. The worker noted this would require coordinated changes across producers and consumers.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Type 'customerGroups' is not assignable to type 'EntityType' errors in generated code suggest the EntityType definition needs updating
